newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Chinese Bank sets US$100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Chinese Bank sets US$100 mln FRCD.

text.p: Hong Kong Chinese Bank has launched a US$100 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said on Thursday.
Jardine Fleming, Societe Generale and Schroders Asia are the arrangers.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with put and call options in years three and four.
The issue was priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.

Management fees are 54 basis points for co-arrangers committing US$10 million or more, 48 basis points for senior managers committing US$5-9 million and 42 basis points for managers committing US$3-4 million.
The borrower is 50 percent held by HKCB Bank Holdings and 50 percent held by China Resources (Holdings).
